text: Hi, thanks for making time today — tell me a bit about what's going on with the house.
I'm the one making this decision, no one else needs to sign off.
Got it. What's driving the timing for you?
We might look at moving sometime next year, nothing urgent yet.
Honestly, we're not sure this is the right time anymore.
That's fair — a lot of people feel that way before they see the actual numbers. Would it help to walk through what the market looks like right now?
Okay, that makes sense, I guess timing isn't the biggest issue.
Great — would sometime next week work for a walkthrough?
Maybe next week could work, let me think about it.
Actually, my wife would really need to be part of this conversation before we go any further.
Of course, happy to loop her in whenever works.
I guess I'm just worried this isn't really the right move for us financially with everything going on.
Totally understand — let's look at your net proceeds after all costs, so you can see the real picture.
That's actually really helpful, tell me more — how does the marketing process work, what about staging, how long does listing usually take?
Please don't start texting me every day before we meet, by the way.
Mornings don't really work for us either, just so you know.
Noted on all of that. What day works best?
Thursday at 3 works, and my wife will be there.
